change_summary.intent: Restore qualification wiring, align the development engine API with the landed module adapter, register dormant migration suites and make legacy source-check workflows read-only. Node production constant-time comparison functions remain unchanged.

operational_impact.operator_notes: Production ct_eq and ct_eq_bytes are unchanged. The test retains its input strategy and 10x limit, measuring warmed alternating batches by medians. Outliers affecting a minority of batches can now pass, including scheduling disturbances or sporadic leakage; persistent content-dependent early exits remain a required negative control. This coarse regression guard does not certify rare/tail leakage or side-channel soundness. The mutation floor retains all three configured source files and 2500 bp, requires the pinned tool schema, and refuses absent/empty/unknown outcomes and rounded-up sub-floor ratios.
required_actions: Keep full inline, feature, fuzz, workspace mutation and hosted qualification open until their named populations actually execute.

Validate default-inline and control-plane/test-support configurations after the observed E0432/E0433 fleet helper gate repair. No test attribute or assertion was removed; 68 fleet tests remain. Default all-target check hit its configured deadline with exit 137, so it is incomplete. The no-default-features inline/test compiler probe is diagnostic and cannot replace default-feature qualification.

Four shared-action callers now use canonical pinned source bootstrap and upload its receipt; action/bootstrap/lock/compiler changes trigger those callers. All 27 bootstrap tests, a real clean five-repository materialization and a real wrong-engine-pin refusal pass. Existing dirty/mismatched checkouts are refused rather than modified; the original dirty-fixture refusal remains retained. No hosted or full-composite execution is claimed. Final pinned remote helper formatting passes with terminal acknowledgment. Helper UBS baseline/candidate counts remain 0 critical, 507 warnings, 141 info; no clean static pass is claimed.

The retained cold inline compile took 6583.427 seconds before source errors, exceeding the old one-hour mutation campaign budget. The draft proposes a three-hour remote campaign, five-minute queue wait and four-hour workflow ceiling, with the same three targets, 60-second per-mutant limit and 2500 bp floor. Longer setup, including a hung setup, can now survive until the new outer deadline; no mutant-acceptance condition is relaxed. The installed RCH configuration resolver confirms the per-call 10800-second build budget. Full-campaign completion remains unmeasured.

The ESM rewrite and corpus-success workflows formerly prepared source corrections and committed/pushed them directly to main. The followup removes write permissions and commit/push steps, refuses tracked changes before validation and again before recording the checked revision, and preserves every validation command byte-for-byte. Sixteen controls exercise both guards in both workflows: clean tracked sources and untracked evidence pass; staged and unstaged tracked mutations refuse. All nine Bash bodies parse and configured actionlint passes. Previously admitted patch-only qualification now refuses, including legacy preparation that still alters tracked source. This is a stricter source-identity boundary, not a passing canonical job or native/runtime proof. Actions remains disabled despite available admin access; no repository setting or hosted dispatch was changed.

Register the existing native_rewrite_transactions and typed_module_rewrites targets that autotests=false left undiscovered. Preserve all20 filesystem/ESM and all8 typed cases, including real Node/Bun before/after execution. The first file now explicitly requires Linux, matching its preexisting Linux-only rollback API and the second file. Its remaining bytes are exact; the typed file is manually formatted with identical pinned-rustfmt output to its original. Both format checks pass. UBS baseline/candidate report0 critical and262 warnings; informational findings88/91 reflect layout-sensitive inventory, not new assertions. Execution of the registered targets remains pending; their names do not establish native-engine parity.

Advance the shared action, inline and mutation bootstrap callers to3d23c93f3b0974d1ccddad1e3639949a36454f21, the first upstream commit exposing that API. This selects27 upstream commits/31 files (7106 insertions/764 deletions), including runtime, strings, providers and tests. Those changes are imported upstream work, not authored capability or a measured win here. Normal workspace/engine manifests and the engine lockfile are unchanged. Strict default all-target check then passes on c53a93a7c plus3d23 (build30081605498307120, ACK true). The unused upstream string-coercion helper warning remains. Real five-repository bootstrap, wrong-C8-pin refusal without receipt, and offline re-verification pass; all27 bootstrap tests pass. Old C8 native/inline probes are cancelled after the shared source blocker is identified, exit143/ACK true, with no executed-test claim. Fresh native/lint/inline qualification remains required.

Add one real-product native integration case for the paired package-error API: two captured error classes across require, require.resolve and dynamic import must permit useful continuation, while nonliteral requests outside the captured route set remain fatal. It obtains each explicitly reviewed incomplete pin through the public CLI and uses the unchanged same-binary supervisor. The exact refusal code is derived from the registry contract before execution. No original case, assertion or ignore is removed. This new test remains unexecuted until its frozen candidate runs.
operational_impact.rollout_notes: Original evidence retains both a 72-test/two-caught-mutant pass and an unchanged-baseline timing failure at 266.98x. First candidate: 70eb13cb9bf6f4dd0dbe1a6d8b786a28af4d0c1a9bf11d25a2ebad0af71d74bd; final module: 4c92c1bdfd6fdab53329b0fd14297ea71ac410817e725ac95f180ae4415da5ec. The final isolated module passes formatting, all-target Clippy with -D warnings, 73 tests, three seeded repeats including the saved regression seed, and both predeclared boolean-return mutant controls. Production function bytes are unchanged. The unsigned-size tautology now exercises truncation refusal and empty equality. A deliberately deficient single-test selection misses the always-true mutant (tool2); the actual workflow floor rejects it (exit1), while genuine caught outcomes pass. Fifteen consumer controls, 27 bootstrap tests, 20 inline-gate tests and configured actionlint pass. Timing UBS baseline/first/final: critical0 each, warnings190/200/202, info19/22/20; added test assertions, bounded indices, checked conversion, needed buffers and guarded division are reviewed, not suppressed. The original full default inline probe fails101 with three errors and416warnings; helper feature conditions are repaired but not compiler-qualified. Default all-target check, default all-target Clippy and the feature-off inline/test diagnostic each time out137 after one hour with terminal acknowledgment. Original/final global formatter probes fail with1856/1859 groups; the new owned import wrap is corrected and final helper formatting passes separately. Full source-summary schema passes; complete no-contract still lacks seven evidence groups. No hosted CI, full workspace mutation score, production rollout, performance win, quantified risk reduction or independent qualification is claimed. Exact source cuts, all failed attempts and raw streams are retained at /Users/jemanuel/.local/state/franken-node-qualification/implementation-20261026-bronzeaspen/.
operational_impact.rollback_notes: Any proposed measurement rollback must preserve the original failure evidence and planted-fault control. The development engine selection changes runtime input and must be reviewed as a coupled source pair: reverting only its pin reintroduces the two observed compiler errors in the landed Node adapter. No automatic deployment, configuration grant or release qualification accompanies this change.

risk_delta.rationale: The engine source selection changes and requires fresh runtime qualification. Better wiring and a less noisy regression measurement do not establish reduced production compromise risk.

compatibility.details: The development Node adapter requires the newer engine error-code API; old-engine source pairing does not compile. All28 newly registered Linux migration cases are preserved. Property inputs, the10x timing limit, three mutant targets, per-mutant60-second budget and2500bp floor remain intact. Source-mutating CI qualification now refuses.
